[2026-03-09 09:43:33] [GP] Saurus Kentaurus: For my 40mil$ 123kt flagships, just fuel and repair, the cheap flight (12h back and forth, 84% eff full and 87% eff empty) cost 6$/t, the best flight (8h b/f, 55% full and 67% empty) cost 7$/t and the fast flight (6h b/f, 40% eff full/empty) cost 9.3$/t. But the ROI from allocated money in the ship at 6% means additional cost per ton of 5$ (fast flight), 6.5$ (best flight) and even 9.75$ (cheap flight). In Sum fuel+shipROI is 13.5$/t (best), 14.3$/t (fast) and 15.8$/t (cheap).
